main.description: Set who can contribute issues, comments, labels, reactions and pulls to a repository this knot hosts. Only the repository owner and the knot's admins can call it. A repository starts from the knot-wide default at creation.

repo.description: DID of the repository this policy change is for

contributionPolicy.description: anyone: any account with a DID can contribute. Members: accounts on this knot's member grant list. Collaborators: the owner and the repository's collaborators.
